text: UntrustVul: Automated Untrustworthy Alert Identification in Vulnerability Detection Models was accepted to be presented at ASE 2026
My dissertation Automated Explanation-Based Testing and Improvement of Trustworthiness in AI-Based Systems got accepted at the Doctoral Symposium track of ASE 2026
My paper "UntrustVul: Automated Untrustworthy Alert Identification in Vulnerability Detection Models" got accepted at IEEE TSE :D
I completed my mid-candidature review. Thrilled to receive a lot of feedback and support from the panel and fellow PhD students.
I will serve on the Program Committee of The 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2026.
I completed my first conference as a presenter and a student volunteer at FSE/ISSTA 2025 in Trondheim, Norway.
I am thrilled to be invited by Prof. David Lo to visit him and his research group at Singapore Management University in August. See you in Singapore!
I will serve on the Program Committee of The 36th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2025.
I have been selected as a Student Volunteer for FSE 2025!
Our paper “Automated Trustworthiness Oracle Generation for Machine Learning Text Classifiers” got accepted by FSE 2025!
Our paper “UntrustVul: An Automated Approach for Identifying Untrustworthy Alerts in Vulnerability Detection Models” is online at arXiv!
